status: A1-D concept v1 - DESIGN TARGETS ONLY. Nothing here is generated terrain or an implementation overlay. Supersedes v0 after the 2026-10-22 preliminary art decisions (D1-D10) and the v1 measurement checks.
units: world metres; x east, z north; heights in metres above sea level

statusVocabulary.fixed: existing R1 / A-R1 geometry that A1 must not change
statusVocabulary.conditional: design target allowed only if the stated condition is met in validation
statusVocabulary.option: alternative presented for art review; not part of the A1 baseline
statusVocabulary.deferred: kept for reference; not part of A1

aretes.name: n-crown arete (N/NE arm)
aretes.intent: sharpest arm: steep concave east flank (C1 headwall), broader stepped west flank to the sea face
aretes.coastalFade: sharpening fades to zero in the 150-300 m coastal taper; the last ~200 m of n-crown toward (-100,3240) stays R1

aretes.name: n-main SE arete
aretes.intent: steep NE flank above C1/C2; ribbed SW flank above the peak-ascent route (B1)

aretes.name: n-main W arete
aretes.intent: broadest arm: lower-angle north flank, gullied south flank; the least sculpted of the three

irregularity.basis: R1 holds all three summit arms within 1.2 m of their authored crest levels (data/hydrology-north-sources.json, crestFidelity), so A1 has no headroom to cut notches or cols into the crests
means: different cross-section per arm (A1 sharp, A2 asymmetric, A3 broad)
different flank character either side of each arm
C1 and C2 differ in aspect, size and depth

option.text: up to three small raised towers (gendarmes) on A1 and A2, each 8-15 m above the authored crest and 20-40 m long; raises only, art approval required

cirques.name: Nordbotn
cirques.headwallReliefM: 145-175 below the n-crown and summit crests (845-900)
cirques.notes: carved into R1's uniform ~33 deg east-facing slope between A1 and A2; outflow follows the existing slope to the NE bay (R1 drainage: sea)

cirques.name: Vastra tarnbotn
cirques.floorM: 622-632, graded east to the source-w threshold
cirques.notes: the R1 source-w knob (2 m) becomes the cirque threshold; the 615 m saddle west of it is filled 5-10 m so the floor drains through the source; floor kept inside the measured High Tarn catchment

variants.text: corrie bench: west/north-west headwall, low natural north side; drains ~2.3 ha headwall zone (90 % inside the authored A-R1 High Tarn catchment 01, 1.3 ha of it currently drained to the sea by R1) to the source-w threshold

enclosed bowl: add a north rim 15-25 m high along (120,2640)-(250,2668)-(380,2650); turns a further 1.03 ha toward High Tarn, all of it inside authored catchment 01 (restores A-R1 hydrology); art approval required

cirques.hydrology: R1 drains only part of the authored High Tarn catchment here (data/hydrology-north-sources.json, authoredCatchment01); C2 moves R1 toward the authored catchment, not away from it

cirques.name: Norra tarnbotn
reasons: v0 floor centre is 21.5 m from the fixed n-east-arc crest line
45 % of the v0 floor drains to the sea in R1
only feasible with the 44-50 m divide raise that D3 declined

cirques.name: Vindbotn
reasons: D2: defer unless its artistic contribution is compelling
visibility from approaches measured in data/silhouettes.json

buttresses.name: south pillar
buttresses.condition: rib crest >= 100 m from the peak-ascent centreline (75 m frozen corridor + rib half-width); must not shed new flow across the route; judged in clay from the route
buttresses.v0Correction: v0 B1 started at (-470,2720), 35 m from the route centreline, inside the frozen corridor; v1 branches from the SE arete 53 m below its crest and keeps >= 100 m from the centreline

buttresses.name: SE-arm east ribs
buttresses.condition: justified only by K1 / valley-shoulder views (A1), not by the Cairn col view (A2)

buttresses.name: Tarnryggen spur rib
buttresses.condition: low priority now that C3 is dropped; must stay clear of the frozen tarn-inlet-n zone

shoulders.name: route shoulder below the final climb
shoulders.v0Correction: v0 placed S1 at (-650,2700), about 100 m off the trail; the real walkable shoulder is the route's traverse at z 2545, inside the frozen corridor

gullies.scope: trial reach only: P0 transect tarn-inlet-w-mid (channel fraction 0.35-0.65)
gullies.section: bed and level fixed; bench +/-4-6 m; asymmetric walls (steeper on the outside of bends); cut 10-15 m into the reconstructed hillslope

gullies.reason: inlet-n stays frozen in A1 pending the source decision (D3)
generalise only after the G1 trial is reviewed (D8)

frozenZones.reason: D3: no A1 edits around the conflicted source until the design-master decision

couloirsAndTalus.scope: C1 and C2 headwalls only; spacing irregular

cameras.purpose: High Tarn north shore: C2 threshold and summit
into Nordbotn from the n-crown arete
windward coast (context for the deferred C4)

scopeBoundary.A1: North Peak sculpture, alpine landforms, glacial valleys, High Tarn connections
scopeBoundary.A2: Cairn Saddle panorama, scenic reveal, route alignment and trail engineering
